name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: Adopt Keychron K4’s dark grey background for the AI website. It signals modernity and tech sophistication, which aligns with AI’s cutting-edge image. The trade-off is losing the playful vibe of the beverage cans site, but clarity and professionalism outweigh whimsy for an AI product.

name: Squint
text: The dark grey background risks making the AI site feel cold and corporate—cutting-edge doesn’t have to mean sterile. A better alternative is Keychron’s dark grey *paired* with the beverage cans’ playful pink accents for contrast, signaling both sophistication and approachability. Settle it by A/B testing both versions with users to see which drives clearer engagement with the AI product’s core message.

name: Easel
text:
Adopt the Keychron K4’s dark grey background as the base for the AI website. It grounds the design in modern tech sophistication, which directly supports the AI product’s cutting-edge identity. The trade-off is sacrificing the beverage cans’ playful pink accents, but a single, strong visual tone keeps the site focused and avoids visual noise.

name: Squint
text: The dark grey risks making the AI site feel like every other tech product—sterile and forgettable. A better alternative is Keychron’s dark grey *with* controlled pink accents (e.g., subtle buttons or highlights) to keep sophistication without drowning in corporate gray. Settle it by A/B testing two versions: one with pure dark grey, one with strategic pink, and measure which keeps users engaged longer.
